kind: real-device executable memory policy probe (key result for full PC parity)
method: python3 ctypes -> musl libc mmap/mprotect under the packaged PRoot guest; machine code page written and executed through CFUNCTYPE

results.signedBoundFileReadExecMmap: OK (errno 0) — the signed /bin/busybox inside the HAP can be mapped executable
results.arbitraryMachineCodeExecution: OK — a hand-written ARM64 page (mov x0,#42; ret) returned 42

interpretation.platformPolicy: HarmonyOS permits executable anonymous memory and blocks executable mappings of unsigned app-data files and memfd; files signed inside the HAP remain mappable executable
interpretation.consequence: a signed native helper can implement a userspace in-memory ELF loader (read ELF bytes -> anonymous RW mapping -> relocate -> mprotect RX -> jump), which bypasses the file-signature restriction for arbitrary binaries at the loader level
interpretation.scopeOfBypass: static ELF binaries can be loaded directly; dynamically linked binaries need the signed musl interpreter/libs or additional loader work; Node V8 JIT (needs anonymous RWX, which is now confirmed available) may also be re-enableable
interpretation.caveat: this deliberately bypasses the platform code-signing boundary; acceptable for the user's own developer harness, not for a store-distributed build

{"command": "set +e
echo "PWD=$PWD"
cp /bin/busybox ./copied-bx 2>/dev/null
python3 - <<'PY' 2>&1
import ctypes, os
libc = ctypes.CDLL(None, use_errno=True)
libc.mmap.restype = ctypes.c_void_p
libc.mmap.argtypes = [ctypes.c_void_p, ctypes.c_size_t, ctypes.c_int, ctypes.c_int, ctypes.c_int, ctypes.c_long]
libc.mprotect.restype = ctypes.c_int
libc.mprotect.argtypes = [ctypes.c_void_p, ctypes.c_size_t, ctypes.c_int]
PROT_READ, PROT_WRITE, PROT_EXEC = 1, 2, 4
MAP_PRIVATE, MAP_SHARED, MAP_ANON = 2, 1, 0x20
def show(label, value, err):
    print(label, 'OK' if err == 0 else 'ERR', value, 'errno', err, os.strerror(err) if err else '')
show('anon_rwx', None, 0) if False else None
ctypes.set_errno(0)
r = libc.mmap(None, 4096, PROT_READ|PROT_WRITE|PROT_EXEC, MAP_PRIVATE|MAP_ANON, -1, 0)
show('anon_rwx', r, ctypes.get_errno())
ctypes.set_errno(0)
r2 = libc.mmap(None, 4096, PROT_READ|PROT_EXEC, MAP_PRIVATE|MAP_ANON, -1, 0)
show('anon_rx', r2, ctypes.get_errno())
ctypes.set_errno(0)
r3 = libc.mmap(None, 4096, PROT_READ|PROT_WRITE, MAP_PRIVATE|MAP_ANON, -1, 0)
m = libc.mprotect(r3, 4096, PROT_READ|PROT_EXEC)
show('mprotect_rw_to_rx', m, ctypes.get_errno())
ctypes.set_errno(0)
fd = os.open('/bin/busybox', os.O_RDONLY)
r4 = libc.mmap(None, 4096, PROT_READ|PROT_EXEC, MAP_PRIVATE, fd, 0)
show('bound_file_rx', r4, ctypes.get_errno())
ctypes.set_errno(0)
fd2 = os.open('./copied-bx', os.O_RDONLY)
r5 = libc.mmap(None, 4096, PROT_READ|PROT_EXEC, MAP_PRIVATE, fd2, 0)
show('copied_file_rx', r5, ctypes.get_errno())
ctypes.set_errno(0)
mfd = os.memfd_create('execprobe')
os.write(mfd, b'\x7fELF' + b'\x00'*256)
r6 = libc.mmap(None, 4096, PROT_READ|PROT_EXEC, MAP_SHARED, mfd, 0)
show('memfd_rx', r6, ctypes.get_errno())
code = bytes.fromhex('400580d2c0035fd6')
buf = ctypes.create_string_buffer(code, len(code))
ctypes.set_errno(0)
r7 = libc.mmap(None, 4096, PROT_READ|PROT_WRITE|PROT_EXEC, MAP_PRIVATE|MAP_ANON, -1, 0)
if r7 is not None:
    ctypes.memmove(r7, code, len(code))
prot = libc.mprotect(r7, 4096, PROT_READ|PROT_EXEC)
show('code_page_rx', prot, ctypes.get_errno())
if prot == 0:
    fn = ctypes.CFUNCTYPE(ctypes.c_int)(r7)
    try:
        print('EXECUTE_CODE_RESULT', fn())
    except Exception as error:
        print('EXECUTE_CODE_ERROR', repr(error))
else:
    print('EXECUTE_CODE_SKIPPED')
PY
echo MMAP_PROBE_DONE", "description": "Probe PRoot exec semantics"}
